h1.en: What Power Cell Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump Prints lists, with Torque as the illustration
h1.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机的动力格子印了什么列出的内容，用「力矩」做插图

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump power text in Xingtai as: Diesel Engine is 4108 / 66–75 kW. An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油搅拌泵一体机的动力文字写成：柴油机是4108 / 66–75 kW。画面「Portland cement」的主体是LDWisconsinTireInject。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque: Torque animation. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump power text in Xingtai as: Diesel Engine is 4108 / 66–75 kW. It does not change this power entry, and a diesel code is not copied onto an electric row. Theoretical Output remains 25 m³/h. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³. A larger motor entry is not a longer pipeline.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque页上的Torque animation。河北品锦机械在邢台把柴油搅拌泵一体机的动力文字写成：柴油机是4108 / 66–75 kW。细石输送（水平/垂直） 100 / 300 m。

heading.en: Definition and relation to other physical quantities
heading.zh: 定义及其与其他物理量的关系

body.en: An electric motor entry is kilowatts on a motor. Diesel Engine is 4108 / 66–75 kW. Max. Outlet Pressure remains 23 MPa. Stone Capacity (H / V, ≤ 1 inch) 100 / 300 m.

A diesel entry names the engine line that is actually shown. Electric drive and diesel drive are different supplies. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not lift kilowatts or an engine code out of that frame. Main-unit weight is 4200 kg.
body.zh: 它不改这一格动力，也不会把柴油机代号抄到电动行上。

body.en: The frame “Portland cement” shows LDWisconsinTireInject. Use the label on this sheet, not the neighbouring model's label. If this row has no voltage entry, none is invented. Those entries, when shown, stay in their own columns.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械不从这一帧里提取千瓦或发动机代号。

question.en: What power text does Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump list?
question.zh: 柴油搅拌泵一体机的动力文字是什么？

answer.en: Diesel Engine is 4108 / 66–75 kW. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque.
answer.zh: 柴油机是4108 / 66–75 kW。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Can a diesel code be moved onto this row?
question.zh: 可以把柴油机代号挪到这一行吗？

answer.en: Only if this row already lists it. Otherwise the entry stays as written. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque.
answer.zh: 只有这一行已经标出了才能算。否则格子保持原样。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What are output and pressure on this sheet?
question.zh: 这一页的输送量和压力是多少？

answer.en: Theoretical Output is 25 m³/h. Max. Outlet Pressure is 23 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque.
answer.zh: 理论输送量是25 m³/h。最大出口压力是23 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torque画面里印出的数字。
